patthana21.29:1.1: na hetuṃ na hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.29:2.1: na hetuṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na nahetuṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.29:3.1: na hetuṃ na paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka namicchattattike hetuduka micchattattikaṃ
